news.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses

news.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
news.summary: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

news.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem

news.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
